content: An EduPyramids Spoken Tutorial

narration: Namaste! Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on The Art of Prompting.
This important tutorial is brought to you by the FOSSEE project, IIT Bombay.
We will learn how to get the best responses from AI tools.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
content: Remember to create clear and specific prompts.
Understand how to add essential context to a prompt.
Apply output format instructions to guide AI responses.
Learn to assign roles or personas for better AI interactions.
narration: By the end of this tutorial, you will remember to create clear prompts.
You will also understand how to add essential context to your requests.
Finally, you will apply various output format instructions.
You will also learn to assign roles for better AI responses.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of learning objectives, maybe icons representing clarity, context, format, and role-playing with AI.

slides.title: Prerequisites
content: Basic understanding of an AI chatbot (Large Language Model).
Access to an AI chatbot (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Llama).
narration: To follow along, you should have a basic understanding of an AI chatbot.
Also, please ensure you have access to any AI chatbot.
Tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, or Copilot will help you practice effectively.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of a person using a computer with a chatbot interface, showing various AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot logos.

slides.title: The Magic Lamp of AI
content: AI chatbots are like a 'magic lamp' for information.
You need to rub the lamp (give a prompt) to get wishes.
A good wish (prompt) gives a good outcome.
A vague wish gives a vague or confusing outcome.
narration: Imagine you have a magic lamp.
An AI chatbot is like the genie inside.
To get what you want, you must give clear instructions or wishes.
A well-worded wish, or prompt, ensures you get what you need.
Let us see how to make our wishes clearer.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoonish illustration of a person holding a magic lamp, a friendly genie emerging from it, looking expectantly at the person. The person looks slightly confused. Warm colors, friendly engaging style, simple clean lines.

slides.title: Be Clear and Specific
content: Vague prompts give vague answers.
Tell AI exactly what you want.
Avoid ambiguous words.
narration: Just like telling the genie 'I want a treat', which could mean anything.
A vague AI prompt gives a general answer.
Instead, tell the genie 'I want a mango ice cream.'
Similarly, be very precise with your AI prompts.
Clear instructions lead to accurate and useful responses.
This saves your time.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoonish split-screen comparison: Left side shows a person asking a genie 'Tell me about cars', the genie looks confused, showing random items like a wheel, a steering wheel, and a car door. Right side shows the same person asking 'Explain differences between electric and gasoline cars', the genie confidently presents two clear car types. Warm colors, friendly engaging style.

slides.title: Demo: Clear and Specific Prompt
content: See how vague and specific prompts work.
Observe the difference in AI's response.
narration: Let us see this in action.
First, we will give a vague prompt and observe the general output.
Then, we will make the prompt very specific.
We will ask for details about electric cars.
Notice how the AI's response becomes more focused and useful.
This helps save your time.
slides.image_prompt: A placeholder image for a video demonstrating AI prompting.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording of user opening an AI chatbot. First, typing 'Tell me about cars' and showing the generic, broad answer. Then, typing 'Summarize key advantages and disadvantages of electric cars versus gasoline cars for a first-time buyer. Keep summary under 150 words.' and showing the concise, targeted answer from the AI chatbot.

slides.title: Add Essential Context
content: Give background information to AI.
Helps AI understand your purpose.
Tailors the response more accurately.
narration: Our genie needs context too.
If you just say 'I need a message,' it won't know for whom or why.
But if you provide the recipient and purpose,
along with the time for your message,
the genie can help you perfectly.
Always provide context to your AI prompts to get relevant answers.
This ensures accuracy.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoonish illustration of a person telling a genie, 'Write a short message'. The genie looks confused, holding a blank scroll. Next, the person adds, 'It's for my colleague Sarah, reminding her about our Q3 report meeting tomorrow at 10 AM'. The genie now confidently writes a detailed message on the scroll, smiling. Warm colors, friendly engaging style.

slides.title: Define Output Format
content: Tell AI how to structure information.
Use lists, tables, or specific lengths.
Ensures easy-to-read results.
narration: After asking for specific information, tell the genie how you want it presented.
Do you want a list, a table, or a short paragraph?
Asking for 'three affordable travel destinations in Europe' is good.
But asking for them as a 'numbered list with best time to visit',
and 'one key attraction in a table format' is even better.
This makes the output very organised.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoonish illustration of a person asking a genie for 'travel destinations'. The genie looks overwhelmed, showing many disorganized images of places. Then, the person asks for 'three affordable travel destinations in Europe, as a numbered list with columns for best time to visit and key attraction'. The genie now presents a neat, structured table with the requested information, smiling. Warm colors, friendly engaging style.

slides.title: Assign a Role or Persona
content: Ask AI to act as a specific role.
Improves relevance and tone of response.
Makes the advice more suitable.
narration: Finally, asking the genie to act as an expert improves its advice.
For example, if you say 'Explain how to bake a cake',
it gives a standard recipe.
But if you say, 'You are a friendly pastry chef',
and 'explain baking a cake for a beginner', the advice is more encouraging.
AI can adopt roles like a chef, teacher, or financial advisor.
This gives you tailored and relevant information.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoonish split-screen illustration: Left side shows a person asking a genie 'Explain how to bake a cake', the genie shows a basic recipe. Right side shows the person asking 'You are an experienced pastry chef. Explain how to bake a simple chocolate cake for a beginner', the genie now wears a chef's hat, explaining with enthusiasm and helpful tips. Warm colors, friendly engaging style.

slides.title: Your Turn! Practice Assignment
content: Improve a vague recipe prompt.
Add context and format to a social media post prompt.
Combine all concepts for a financial advice prompt.
narration: Now, it is your turn to practice.
Use your AI chatbot and apply what you have learned.
First, improve a vague recipe prompt.
Then, add context and format instructions to a social media post prompt.
Finally, combine all the concepts to get financial advice from the AI.
This will strengthen your prompting skills.
Have fun with it!
slides.image_prompt: Cartoonish illustration of a student sitting at a desk, enthusiastically typing on a laptop, a thought bubble above their head shows various improved prompts. The student looks happy and focused. Warm colors, friendly engaging style.

slides.title: Summary
content: Be clear and specific in your prompts.
Always add essential context for relevance.
Define the desired output format.
Assign roles to AI for better tone and perspective.
narration: In summary, remember to be clear and specific in your prompts to AI.
Always add essential context so the AI understands your purpose well.
Define how you want the output to be formatted.
Finally, assign a role or persona to the AI to get more relevant advice.
Mastering these tips will make you an expert prompt writer.
